profile_text: Specializing in logistics and industrial properties in Germany, this real estate management company has experienced significant growth, with a 67.6% increase in employees since its baseline. Its focus on managing properties that support the country's thriving logistics sector has driven its expansion, catering to the needs of businesses that rely on efficient supply chain operations. With 62 employees as of 2024, the company continues to scale its operations to meet the demand for high-quality industrial and logistics spaces.
